AUTHOR: M. Liu
TITLE: FD-Net: A Model Based on Deep Learning for Deep-Sea Fish Detection
VENUE: 2023 IEEE 7th Information Technology and Mechatronics Engineering Conference (ITOEC)
SPECIES: 8 fish species tags + generic 'Fish' class (species not named)
DATA: OzFish public BRUV dataset (2,004 images, 43,572 labelled fish)
D_EV: Sec. IV-B: 'divides the OzFish dataset into training and validation sets in an 8:2 ratio'
R_EV: Sec. IV-C: 'performance evaluation metrics of YOLOv5, YOLOv6, YOLOv7 and FD-Net on the OzFish test set'
E_EV: Table I: only 'mAP(%) Precision(%) Recall(%) F1(%)' reported
ARCH: FD-Net (YOLOv5-style single-stage detector with MRCP, DmPooling, DACM modules)
NOTE: Split given only as 8:2 ratio with no unit or randomisation stated -> D1 NR (could be image-level random; not using OzFish predefined split). Paper mislabels OzFish as 'deep-sea'; ENV not stated in paper. Results reported on 'OzFish test set' although only train/val split described. Low-contrast statement in methods is generic, not about measured data conditions. DSHR=N: no new data shared (OzFish itself is public).
